english.title: Acknowledge a recognizance / bail / judgement / deed for another before a judge / court / authorised person
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without lawful authority or excuse, acknowledged

(A)_[a recognisance, namely **(..SPECIFY THE RECOGNISANCE..),]_
(B)_[bail, namely **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF THE BAIL..),]_
(C)_[cognovit actionem , namely **(..SPECIFY..),]_
(D)_[judgment, namely **(..SPECIFY THE JUDGMENT..),]_
(E)_[deed, namely **(..SPECIFY THE DEED..),]_
(F)_[other instrument, namely **(..SPECIFY THE INSTRUMENT..),]_

in the name of **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..) before a

(G)_[judge,]_
(H)_[court,]_
(I)_[person lawfully authorised in that behalf,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY THE JUDGE / COURT / PERSON..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 34 of the Forgery Act 1861.
